product.description: The sweetest little friend is back, now in mini! This Puffed footmuff features an all-over print of mini teddy bears on a calm background, adding a soft and familiar touch on the go. Suitable for 3- and 5-point harnesses, it fits most group 0+ car seats and strollers. product.name: Stuffed Animal with Light and Sound - Sheep Sonny / Normal
product.short_description:
New product alert! Discover our stuffed animals with light and sound: soft little friends made not only for cuddles, but also to help your little one relax. These stuffed animal toys are wonderfully soft and perfect to hold. Inside each cuddly toy is a soothing light and sound box with six different options: three natural sounds and three gentle melodies. Choose from the calming sound of waves, a softly flowing stream, or a familiar womb sound with heartbeat. The cuddly toys also play lovely lullabies, including Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Hush Little Baby, and Rock-a-bye Baby.

The combination of sound, music, and soft light helps create a calm, cosy, and secure atmosphere. The light also has several options: choose from pink, yellow, green, purple, blue, red, or changing colours. Hold the colour button a little longer, and the cuddly toy switches to soothing night mode with soft white light. With the sound button, you can easily switch between sounds and adjust the volume. Even better: the cuddly toy features cry detection, so the sound automatically starts playing again when your little one becomes unsettled. This stuffed animal toy is rechargeable and comes with a handy USB-C cable. A cuddly toy that not only offers comfort, but also helps create a calm and secure feeling. Will you choose Bear Brave or Sheep Sonny?

All our sleeping bags are made from wonderfully soft and breathable fabric and feature the trendiest prints, specially created by our design team, so your little one can always sleep in style, no matter the season. All sleeping bags also have a safe and comfortable zipper, making dressing and undressing as easy as possible. So from tiny newborns to cheeky toddlers, and from balmy summer nights to cold winter days, we make sure your child sleeps soundly! This lovely baby sleeping bag has removable sleeves. Is it a bit colder? Simply zip the sleeves back on. Shop our sleeping bags in different colours and in sizes 60, 70, 90 and 110cm!

product.name: Wrap Blanket Sherpa - Merino Wool - Natural / 80x80 cm
product.description: Wrap your little one up in this beautiful merino wool wrap blanket in the colour Natural or Dark Hazel. Soft, pure and with a lovely natural look, just what you need for those first cosy moments together. Merino wool is known for its temperature-regulating properties. It keeps your baby warm when it’s cold, and comfortably snug when the weather is milder. Perfect for every season. The wool also feels ultra-soft and is gentle on delicate baby skin. Another lovely benefit: merino wool is naturally antibacterial and self-cleaning. Often, simply airing it out is enough. Plus, it’s a fully natural and biodegradable material, making it a conscious and sustainable choice. Thanks to the practical Velcro closure, you can wrap your little one up easily and safely. The openings at the back make this wrap blanket suitable for use in the car seat with harness straps. Perfect from birth and a must-have for home and on the go.

product.name: Sleeping bag with removable sleeves round - Merino Wool Felted - Natural / 60cm
product.short_description: Give your little one a wonderfully comfortable and secure night’s sleep with this lovely merino wool sleeping bag. The natural, soft look and subtle felted material make this sleeping bag not only beautiful to look at, but also especially pleasant to use. Merino wool is known for its temperature-regulating properties: it keeps your baby warm when it’s cold and helps provide cooling when temperatures rise. That makes this sleeping bag perfect for every season. The wool feels ultra-soft and is gentle on sensitive baby skin. Merino wool is also naturally antibacterial and self-cleaning, so airing it out is often enough to keep the sleeping bag fresh. A conscious and sustainable choice, as the material is completely natural and biodegradable. This sleeping bag has detachable sleeves. Is it a little cooler? Simply zip the sleeves on. When it gets warmer, you can remove them just as easily. The comfortable zipper makes changing and dressing your little one quick and easy. A lovely, versatile sleeping bag in which your baby can sleep safely and comfortably, all year round. Shop our sleeping bags in various colours and in sizes 60, 70 and 90cm!

Party collection - 50 years

It's time to celebrate! Jollein is 50 years old. Since 1973, Jollein has been selling beautiful and affordable essentials for you and your baby. Colour

The flag line has the colours Biscuit and Ivory.

Material

The cute flags are made of 100% muslin cotton.

Size

Washing

Each sleeping bag has a safe and comfortable zipper, making it as easy as possible to put on and take off. product.name: Wrap Blanket - Teddy Bear
product.short_description: Wrap blanket with guaranteed mega cuteness factor. It has fluffy fur-look fabric on the outside, and it's super comfortably soft on the inside. Wrap your baby up and close the blanket with the practical velcro strips. Put the little hat on, with adorable little ears and a little bear face. Too cute! This wrap blanket can be used from birth. And it's also practical to use in your baby's first car seat. You can put the belts of the car seat through the openings in the blanket, so your baby can stay in their wrap. It's a universal wrap blanket for the Maxi Cosi and every other brand of category 0 cat seat with three or five point seatbelts. Available in various colours.

product.name: Footmuff group 0+ 3/5 points - Basic Knit - Stone Grey / One Size
product.description: This soft and warm footmuff is perfect for the car seat or stroller. The outside features a stylish knitted structure, and the inside is made of wonderfully soft velvet. With convenient openings, it fits 3- or 5-point harnesses, making it suitable for group 0+ car seats, Maxi-Cosi, and strollers. Available in a range of neutral colours that go with everything! This footmuff does not have a TOG rating, as it is designed to keep your little one warm on the go and not to be used as a sleeping bag.

product.name: Giftset Jollein x Naïf
product.short_description: Discover the perfect fusion of two amazing brands in our special gift sets: Naïf and Jollein.
product.description:
Discover the perfect fusion of two amazing brands in our special gift sets: Naïf and Jollein.

Meet the “Wipe for the Future” gift set from Jollein x Naïf — a carefully curated collection with the finest products to care for your little one. Change your baby with the soothing lotion and water wipes, and use Naïf’s diaper cream for soft and protected skin. While you’re busy, your mini can enjoy the adorable Fox music hanger and the comfort of Jollein’s soft changing mat cover.

All these beautiful items come tastefully packaged in a luxurious box, making giving (and receiving!) this gift set a true celebration.
The perfect care, the perfect gift!

What it is

The ultimate gift set for changing with ease — and in style.
The set includes:

  • Jollein Music Hanger Fox

  • Jollein Changing Mat Cover

  • Naïf Plastic-Free Lotion Baby Wipes (1 pack)

  • Naïf Plastic-Free Water Baby Wipes (1 pack)

  • Naïf Diaper Cream 0% Perfume (75ml)

What it does

This set turns diaper changing into a joyful moment.
Naïf’s products gently cleanse and care for your baby’s skin, while Jollein’s items wrap your little one in softness and comfort.

What’s in it (and what’s not)

Naïf’s products contain no microplastics and are made with natural ingredients.

Materials & Ingredients:

  • Music Hanger Fox – Outer: 100% cotton | Filling: 100% polyester

  • Changing Mat Cover – 100% cotton

  • Plastic-Free Lotion Wipes – Made from wood fibers with nourishing natural ingredients like aloe vera and bamboo

  • Plastic-Free Water Wipes – Made from eucalyptus fibers and composed of 99% water

  • Diaper Cream 0% Perfume – With natural ingredients such as zinc oxide, chamomile, and vitamin E

How to use
Let Jollein’s Fox music hanger entertain your little one while you gently clean with Naïf’s plastic-free baby wipes.
Apply the diaper cream with zinc oxide to prevent or soothe diaper rash — all while using Jollein’s soft changing mat cover.
Got a mess? Just pop the cover in the wash!

Gift Set Size

20 x 20 x 20 cm

product.name: Wrap Blanket Basic - Stripe
product.short_description: Nice basic wrap blanket from Jollein. This lovely padded wrap blanket is a real must-have for every baby. The wrap blanket is very nice to keep your little one warm, both at home and on the road. The wrap blanket has handy Velcro strips through which you can easily pull the belt of the car seat. After you have placed your little one in the wrap blanket, close it with the Velcro strips so they can no longer go anywhere. This gives your baby a sense of security and he will stay nice and warm. Is it chilly outside? The hoodie with cute ears offers a solution. The wrap blanket is lightly lined, making it nice and warm. The outside of the wrap blanket is made of 50% viscose and 50% cotton, the inside is made of 100% cotton and the filling is made of fibre fill polyester. The dimensions of the wrap blanket are 105x100 cm and it is available in nougat, pink (rosewood) and blue. The wrap blanket can be machine washed at a maximum temperature of 40 degrees, it cannot be put in the drier, but you can iron it. View the attached care label for detailed washing instructions.

product.name: Bib Waterproof - Meadow - 2 Pack
product.short_description: Is your little one also keen on exploring during the meal? This could turn into a mess. That is what makes these bibs perfect. the bibs can easily be taken off after a huge mess was made and have a convenient drip tray, so you don't need to clean the floor after your little one has finished his meal. The bib has a great Velcro closure on the back so that it will remain in place and cannot be taken off easily by your little rascal himself. Handy waterproof bib by Jollein. The waterproof bib is available in 2-pack and is available with flower print Meadow in pink (rosewood) and brown (chestnut), in elephant print Savannah and in the fruit print of Peach and Phandle. But also available with rainbow print and snake print in pink and grey. The bib is made of polyester and polyurethane.

product.name: Wet Wipes Cover - Silicone
product.short_description: Wet wipes and face towels can now easily be stored in this handy silicone wet wipes case. The box is suitable for all sizes wet wipes and face cloths and has a handy opening at the centre to take the cloths from the packaging one by one. The cloth can easily be put back into the box, to prevent drying out of the cloths. The silicone baby wet wipes case has a handy storage box for diapers. This way you have everything at hand at once, to make changing your little one as quick and as easy as possible. Because we all know that once a baby starts rolling over, this may be quite a challenge!
product.description:
Wet wipes and face towels can now easily be stored in this handy silicone wet wipes case. The box is suitable for all sizes wet wipes and face cloths and has a handy opening at the centre to take the cloths from the packaging one by one. The cloth can easily be put back into the box, to prevent drying out of the cloths. The silicone baby wet wipes case has a handy storage box for diapers. This way you have everything at hand at once, to make changing your little one as quick and as easy as possible. Because we all know that once a baby starts rolling over, this may be quite a challenge!

The wet wipes case is available in 6 bright colours.

Mix & Match

During the changing at home, use a changing mat to protect your furniture against accidents. The Jollein changing mat is available in the web shop!

About the theme

The silicone items of Jollein are trendy, practical and stylish. Each of the products are lovely presents to give and to receive. The products are easy to use, can go in the dishwasher, oven and freezer and make it as easy as possible for the parents to practise with food and will be a stylish addition to the table! The collection is available in nougat, storm grey, jeans blue, pale pink, ash green and caramel.

product.name: Baby Sleeping Bag with Removable Sleeves - Teddy Bear - Multicolor / 90cm
product.description: Looking for the ultimate sleeping experience for your little one? All our sleeping bags are made of wonderfully soft and breathable material and feature the trendiest prints, specially designed by our design team, so your little one can always sleep in style, whatever the season. All sleeping bags also feature a secure and comfortable zip to make putting on and taking off as easy as possible. So from newborn minis to naughty toddlers and from balmy summers to cold winters, we'll make sure your child sleeps well! This fine baby sleeping bag has detachable sleeves. This is how you transform it from a TOG value of 3.5 for cold winter days to a TOG value of 2.5 for chilly nights in spring and autumn. Shop this sleeping bag in several fun prints and in 70, 90 and 110 cm! so you're sure to find the perfect fit for your little one.

product.description: How cute is this bath robe? A terry bath robe is always handy for your toddler. The bath robe is perfect to use after a bath, shower or swim. product.name: Musical Hanger - Spring Garden
product.short_description: This sweet little flower will sing for your little one! This musical hanger plays the tune ''Lullaby'' when you pull the string. This can have a calming effect on your baby. Tip: Play the tune frequently near your belly while you're pregnant, and you will see that it'll feel familiar and soothing to your newborn baby. That's why the musical hanger is a great baby shower gift. And it's also a perfect maternity gift. Also available with a cute little duck.
product.description:
This sweet little flower will sing for your little one! This musical hanger plays the tune ''Lullaby'' when you pull the string. This can have a calming effect on your baby. Tip: Play the tune frequently near your belly while you're pregnant, and you will see that it'll feel familiar and soothing to your newborn baby. That's why the musical hanger is a great baby shower gift. And it's also a perfect maternity gift. Also available with a cute little duck.

Spring Garden

Look how cute! The Jollein collection has been expanded with activity toys. These items will stimulate the senses of your little one and provide hours of entertainment for your baby. You can use these fun baby toys in the stroller, in the playpen, in the carseat or in the buggy. Perfect for at home and on a trip! The toys depict all kinds of things that you can spot in the park. Such as a little flower, a duck, a bee and a ladybug. Your little one will have fun discovering all of them. Which is your favourite?

Colour

The musical hanger is available in the colours: Nougat, Biscuit, Honey Gold and Chestnut

Material

100% Boucle polyester. The inside is filled with 100% polyester fibre fill

Washing instructions

You cannot wash the musical hanger.

product.name: Sheet - Family
product.short_description: With a white sheet, you can make your baby's bed safe and neat. If you tuck the sides of the sheet under the mattress, your baby won't just sleep safely, they will also have a sense of security. This sweet sheet with the text 'Family' is a perfect match with blankets from the Pure Knit theme by Jollein. With a canopy or veil in the colour Biscuit, your little one's room will be complete!

100% cotton.

product.name: Changing Mat Cover - Shell Knit
product.short_description: Your little one will spend a lot of time on a changing mat. And how perfect is this lovely cotton knitted changing mat cover? The beautiful knit makes the cover look luxurious. What's more, this cover is 100% GOTS! You can easily close the cover with press-studs, so that it will stay in place around the changing mat, without shifting. You'll notice that you can never have too many changing mat covers. You'll be changing the changing mat cover at least once a day, and usually even multiple times a day.
product.description:
Your little one will spend a lot of time on a changing mat. And how perfect is this lovely cotton knitted changing mat cover? The beautiful knit makes the cover look luxurious. What's more, this cover is 100% GOTS! You can easily close the cover with press-studs, so that it will stay in place around the changing mat, without shifting. You'll notice that you can never have too many changing mat covers. You'll be changing the changing mat cover at least once a day, and usually even multiple times a day.

Shell Knit collection

Our latest knit! The lovely knitted pattern provides a luxurious look, and it's comfortably warm and soft. The Shell Knit collection is available in the colours: Wild Rose, Sea Foam and Nougat. This collection offers blankets for the cradle and cot and changing mat covers. Furthermore, all items are GOTS certified! This means that you can take extra good care of your little one. You can perfectly combine the Shell Knit collection with items from the Rosehip collection or the Farm collection.

Colour

Available in three colours: Wild Rose, Sea Foam and Nougat.

Material

The changing mat cover is made of 100% cotton (GOTS).

Size

With a size of 50x70 cm, this cover will fit perfectly around the Jollein changing mat, and all changing mats of a standard size.

Washing

You can wash the cover at 30 degrees. Lay it down flat to dry. For more instructions, check the washing label.

Things don't always stay tidy when it's time to eat, and a lot of the time there will be quite the mess. A bib will protect your little one's clothes, so that your child will be all fresh and clean again after eating. And it's not just a practical item for meal times. product.name: Changing Mat Cover Jersey - Happy Miffy
product.description:
How cute is this changing mat cover with Miffy print? An adorable jersey cover that will fit around the Jollein changing mat perfectly, the most practical basic of your baby equipment. The fabric is soft and stretchy. Thanks to the elastic in the edges, the cover will stay in place around the mat. And thanks to the print, it looks utterly adorable. Available in Olive Green and Nougat.
The changing mat is cold without a cover, and plastic is not very comfortable. A loose towel will slip and slide, and won't cover the edges. A standard muslin cloth is too small and thin to cover the changing mat properly.
This changing mat cover will stay in place like a fitted sheet, you can wash it in no time, and your baby (and you) will feel comfortable. Sounds great, right?
We recommend purchasing multiple changing mat covers. This way, you will always have a spare after a little accident.

product.name: Babygym Toys - Animals
product.short_description: From 10 weeks old, your baby will need more and more stimuli, play time and things to see. This is the perfect time to challenge them with a baby gym. Get the wooden baby gym and decorate it with these cute figures from the Animals theme. The cheerful toys come in the shape of an elephant, a bear and a giraffe. Put your baby under it on a soft surface, and they can play to their heart's content! Your baby will be fascinated by the way the little toys move on the baby gym. They will kick their feet excitedly or make little noises when they manage to grab a toy, or tap against it so it will move even more. Using the baby gym will stimulate your baby's gross and fine motor skills. It stimulates the senses. Furthermore, your baby will get more and more control of their grabbing technique, and learn that the toys will move more if they touch them. So a baby gym is very valuable. The baby gym toys from Jollein are exclusively made for the baby gym. The baby gym is available separately, and easy to install. The Jollein collection offers even more matching baby gym toys. The toys are easy to attach and remove. This means that you can switch the toys and keep things interesting and challenging for your baby. Tip: you can also attach the toys to the Maxi Cosi, for example.

product.name: Footmuff buggy/stroller - Puffed - Grey / One Size
product.description: This footmuff is perfect for your little one in the stroller or buggy. A real must-have for cold winter days. You can open the footmuff with the zipper, which moves both ways, so you can easily put your baby in and take them out again. The back of the footmuff has a practical hood, which you can fold around the head support of the buggy. This way, the footmuff will stay properly in place. The footmuff is water-repellent, so your baby will be warm and dry! Which colour will you get? This footmuff does not have a TOG rating, as it is designed to keep your little one warm on the go and not to be used as a sleeping bag.

In addition, the washcloth has cute ears and a handy loop to hang it on. The washcloth is ideal for washing your little one or to take with you for messy mishaps on the go. You can choose from 6 nice colours and it matches perfectly with the bathrobe with ears.  The washcloth is made of 100% cotton and measures 42x16 cm. The washcloth is available in pink, caramel, nougat, ivory, green and blue. You can wash the washcloth in the washing machine at a temperature of up to 40 degrees, can be ironed and dried in the dryer. See the care label for detailed washing instructions.

product.name: Bib Silicone - Nougat / One Size
product.short_description: Your little one can now mess around in style with this flexible silicone bib. The bib has a unicolor, is dishwasher safe, and has a handy collection tray so you no longer have to get on your hands and knees to clean the floor after every meal. Due to the adjustable closure, the bib can be used for a long time. Available in 4 trendy colours!

product.name: Bathcape - Teddy Bear - GOTS
product.short_description: This bath cape is perfect after bath time or swimming. You can wrap it around your baby as soon as they get out of the water. And you can cover their head with the hood, so they will stay perfectly warm. Amazing comfort for your baby! This bath cape is made of 100% terry cotton. The outside is made of 100% Jersey.
product.description:
This bath cape is perfect after bath time or swimming. You can wrap it around your baby as soon as they get out of the water. And you can cover their head with the hood, so they will stay perfectly warm. Amazing comfort for your baby! This bath cape is made of 100% terry cotton. The outside is made of 100% Jersey.

The soft terry is mild for tender baby skin and absorbs moisture, so your child will be dry in no time. After you, you can easily hang the cape by its practical loop. The bath cape has a size of 75x75cm. The bath cape has a super cute Teddy Bear print. Would you rather have one without a print? Jollein also sells basic bath capes without print!

Colour

The Ivory background perfectly matches the Chestnut and Biscuit coloured bears. You can iron this item, but it's better not to. This fabric will absorb more moisture if it hasn't been ironed. And that's what you need when drying your baby.

product.name: Sofa Beanbag - Mellow Pink / One Size
product.short_description: Kids enjoy being able to sit there. This beanbag is handy to place at the coffee table to play a game together, to chill out and watch television. In addition, it is also cosy in the living room or bedroom. The beanbag can be used for a long time by kids from 1 to 4 years. The material makes it easy to keep clean with a damp cloth.
product.description:
Kids enjoy being able to sit there. This beanbag is handy to place at the coffee table to play a game together, to chill out and watch television. In addition, it is also cosy in the living room or bedroom. The beanbag can be used for a long time by kids from 1 to 4 years. The material makes it easy to keep clean with a damp cloth.

Nice beanbag from Jollein. The beanbag is suitable for children from 1 year and can be used up to and including 4 years. The beanbag is available in the colours grey, rust and mustard and is made of PVC and filled with EPS beans. The dimensions of the armchair are 40x46x37 cm.

This product is not suitable for washing in the washing machine or to dry in the dryer. However, the product can be wiped with a damp cloth (do not use chemicals).

product.name: Footmuff group 0+ 3/5 points - Boucle - Naturel / One Size
product.description: A foot muff is a really practical item. And how cute is this foot muff made of super cuddly Boucle! You can put your baby in the foot muff by zipping open the bag all the way. And if you want to take your baby out of the car seat, you can also zip open the foot muff completely. The topside of the foot muff can be changed in a cap with press-stud super quickly. This way, your baby's head will stay warm when you carry the car seat out of the car or when taking a walk. To make sure your baby won't get too warm when in the car, you can open the zipper as far as necessary. In short: a super handy comfort bag for your baby. The foot muff has openings at the back through which you can easily attach the belts. This is a universal foot muff for the Maxi Cosi and any other brand category 0 car seat with three-point or five-point belt. You can also use this comfort bag in the pram. This way, your baby will be wrapped up warm and comfy for your walk. You can also attach the foot muff to the pram from the back so that it won't slide off. Fantastic! Available in the colours Biscuit and Storm Grey. The outside is made of 100% polyester. The inside is made of soft Jersey cotton. The padding is made of 100% polyester fibre fill. The comfort bag is 52x110 cm. You can wash the foot muff at maximum 30 degrees. Follow the instructions on the wash label. This footmuff does not have a TOG rating, as it is designed to keep your little one warm on the go and not to be used as a sleeping bag.

product.name: Bib Waterproof with Sleeves - Teddy Bear
product.short_description: This bib with sleeves is amazing. It's kind of like an apron, and it gives the clothes of your baby or toddler extra protection thanks to the sleeves.
product.description:
This bib with sleeves is amazing. It's kind of like an apron, and it gives the clothes of your baby or toddler extra protection thanks to the sleeves.

And why is there a double layer of fabric at the bottom? There's a good reason for it! While eating, your child will often let some food drop down their chin and onto the bib. The lower edge of the bib will catch these blobs and chunks. So it's kind of like a leak tray! Something you will definitely appreciate!

This bib is not just very practical for meals, it also makes crafts and fingerpainting a lot less stressful. Because with this painting apron you can be sure: the clothes will stay clean!

The fluids and blobs on the front side of the bib will not leak to the clothes. That's because this bib is made of waterproof material.

You can close the waterproof bib with velcro at the back. It will close properly, so that your baby won't be able to take it off by themselves. The bib can be easily cleaned with a moist cloth. Are there a lot of mess-making moments in one day? Then you should get a duo-pack. So that you will have two of the same bibs with one purchase.

Teddy Bear collection

This sweet teddy bear print is irresistible! The cute teddy bear will keep your baby company. We have various products with this print, like sleeping bags, bibs and even a playpen mat. You can match the Teddy Bear print with the items from our Boucle collection.

Available as a single bib and duo-pack.

Colour

The bib is available with a fun print with cute Teddy Bears. It's also available in other prints and colours. Which is your favourite?

Size

Suitable for your baby, until they are about 2 years old.

Material

Made of polyester and polyutherane.

Cleaning

Wipe it down with a moist cloth.

product.description: Use a hot water bottle for your little one with this lovely hot water bottle bag in soft terry cloth in the colour Sand. The natural, calm shade fits perfectly in any nursery. Thanks to the handy tie closure at the top, the hot water bottle stays securely in place and is easy to open and close. With a size of 35 x 10cm, it is suitable for a standard hot water bottle. product.name: Changing Mat Cover Jersey - Teddy Bear
product.short_description: A cute jersey cover with a print of teddy bears that fits perfectly around your changing mat is the most practical basic in your layette. The fabric is soft and stretchy. Thanks to the elastic around the edge, the cover will stay properly in place around the cushion. And with this fun Teddy Bear print, it will also look cute and beautiful. Without a cover, the changing mat is pretty cold, and the plastic is not very comfortable. A loose towel will slip off, and it won't cover the edges. A standard hydrophilic cloth is too small and too thin to cover the changing mat properly. This changing mat cover will stay firmly in place, like a fitted sheet. You can easily wash it, and it will make your baby (and you) feel comfortable. Doesn't that sound great? We recommend buying multiple covers. There will always be at least one cover in the laundry. Changing mat covers have a lot to deal with. Like “Oops… the milk is running down my cheeks onto the cover” or “Ah.. I'll start peeing now that my diaper is off”. You can count on it… you will have to change the changing mat cover at least once a day, and sometimes even multiple times a day.

product.name: Bib Waterproof - Teddy Bear - 2 Pack
product.short_description: These bibs are amazing. They're kind of like aprons, protecting the clothes of your baby or toddler.
product.description:
These bibs are amazing. They're kind of like aprons, protecting the clothes of your baby or toddler.

And why is there a double layer of fabric at the bottom? There's a good reason for it! While eating, your child will often let some food drop down their chin and onto the bib. The lower edge of the bib will catch these blobs and chunks. So it's kind of like a leak tray! Something you will definitely appreciate!

The fluids and blobs on the front side of the bib will not leak to the clothes. That's because this bib is made of waterproof material.

You can close the waterproof bib with velcro at the back. It will close properly, so that your baby won't be able to take it off by themselves. The bib can be cleaned with a moist cloth. It has a Teddy Bear print.

Teddy Bear

This sweet teddy bear print is irresistible! The cute teddy bear will keep your baby company. We have various products with this print, like sleeping bags, bibs and even a playpen mat. You can match the Teddy Bear print with the items from our Boucle collection.

Colour

The waterproof bib is delivered in a practical 2-pack and is available with a fun Teddy Bear print.

Size

Can be used for babies, until your child is about 2 years old.

Material

Made of polyester and polyutherane.

Cleaning

Wipe down with a moist cloth.

product.name: Washcloth Muslin - Teddy Bear - 3 Pack
product.short_description: Muslin Washcloths are very practical for bath time with your baby. They're also great for a quick wash in the morning on the changing mat. Thanks to the thin and smooth fabric, you can easily clean the sensitive skin folds or below your baby's skin without damaging the skin. It's also very practical on a daytrip, to clean dirty mouths and hands. Because of its small size, the washcloth is perfect to bring in a sleepover bag. The washcloths are delivered in a practical 3-pack. Because you can never have too many washcloths. All washcloths in this 3-pack have a sweet all-over Teddy Bear print. product.short_description: This teething ring is perfect for all the mouthing and biting that your baby does. When your baby is teething, it can be an extra good idea to have this teething ring prepared in the refrigerator (never in the freezer). The cold teething ring will numb the annoying feeling in their gums a little. This teething ring is extra practical. While teething, your baby may not feel very well. And no wonder: the tooth is coming out through the gums, and this hurts or itches. You can usually see it in the baby's mouth: a hard bump and red or swollen gums. It's hard work for your baby! Your little one will like biting on something to soothe the pain. This will ease the pressure on the gums while teething. This teething ring of 100% natural rubber can be used for all ages, and is safe for your baby from 0 months.
product.description:
This teething ring is perfect for all the mouthing and biting that your baby does. When your baby is teething, it can be an extra good idea to have this teething ring prepared in the refrigerator (never in the freezer). The cold teething ring will numb the annoying feeling in their gums a little. This teething ring is extra practical. While teething, your baby may not feel very well. And no wonder: the tooth is coming out through the gums, and this hurts or itches. You can usually see it in the baby's mouth: a hard bump and red or swollen gums. It's hard work for your baby! Your little one will like biting on something to soothe the pain. This will ease the pressure on the gums while teething. This teething ring of 100% natural rubber can be used for all ages, and is safe for your baby from 0 months.

Colour

Available in the colour Biscuit.

Material

100% natural rubber (latex) and does not contain hazardous substances: 100% free of PVC, BPA, phtalates and nitrosamins.

Cleaning

Simply clean the outside with a moist cloth and let it dry.

Safety

Your child will put this toy in their mouth. That's why it's important to always check the ring before use. Remove all plastic, cords and/or attachments before giving the ring to your child. This teething ring is not suitable for boiling or freezing, and may not be put in the microwave or dishwasher. This product contains natural rubber latex, which can cause allergic reactions. So that is important to keep an eye on. Do not leave your child alone with this toy, stay near your child and pay attention. Does not contain hazardous substances like PVC, BPA, phtalates and nitrosamins. In compliance with the safety regulations of EN71.

product.name: Canopy Vintage Ruffle 245cm - Ivory / One Size
product.short_description: With this vintage-look canopy with ruffles, you can make your baby's bed a cosy place to sleep. And you'll see: as soon as you put the canopy in place, your baby's room will be finished. It provides atmosphere and a sense of security.
product.description:
With this vintage-look canopy with ruffles, you can make your baby's bed a cosy place to sleep. And you'll see: as soon as you put the canopy in place, your baby's room will be finished. It provides atmosphere and a sense of security.

With a matching support, you can easily install the canopy without having to drill holes in the ceiling or wall. Thanks to the support with ring, the canopy will be in place in no time.

The support is not included with the veil, but it is available at Jollein.

Colour

This vintage-look canopy with ruffles is available in Ivory, Rosewood and Nougat. The version without ruffles is available in various other trendy colours. Furthermore, we offer matching sheets, fitted sheets and blankets. Do you want a baby room that is fit for Instagram?

Size

245 cm long. With the matching support of 220 cm the canopy will be installed at the perfect height.

Material

The veil is made of 80% polyester and 20% cotton.

Washing tips

You can wash the veil on the hand wash cycle. Hang it back in place to let it dry. Do not put it in the dryer; ironing is okay. Following the washing instructions on the washing label.

Extra tip: the perfect atmosphere for bigger kids as well

The canopy is perfect for a baby room. As soon as it's been installed, the room will have the right atmosphere.

But once your baby starts to crawl and grab things, it's possible that they'll pull the canopy into their bed and chew on it. As a result, you'll have moist fabric with some snot here and there. Not very hygienic. It might be better to take the canopy down during this phase, but definitely keep it in storage for a while. Once your child is bigger, you can put the canopy back for the right atmosphere and a sense of security in your toddler's room.

This blanket has an Ivory background, and the little bears on the print are available in the colours Biscuit and Chestnut. The back of the blanket is made of fleece in the colour Biscuit.

TOG value

With a size of 100x150 cm, this blanket is perfect to use in a cot. The blanket is also available in the size 75x100 cm, which is perfect for a cradle.

product.name: Teething Ring - Bunny
product.short_description: This teething ring can be comfortably put your baby's mouth to suck and bite. When teething, it can be extra nice to put the teether in the fridge before use (never in the freezer). The cold teething ring slightly numbs the unpleasant feeling on the gums. This teether is available in six different shapes. Each shape has its own colour. Every shape is easy for your baby to grab and hold. Teething can make your baby feel ill. Not surprising, of course: the tooth squeezes its way through the gums and that hurts or makes it itchy. You can often see it in the mouth: a hard bump and red or swollen gums. It's hard work for your baby! To ease the pain a bit, it is nice for your little one to bite on something. This relieves the pressure on the gums during the erupting teeth. This natural rubber teether can be used by all ages and is safe for your baby from 0 months.

product.short_description: Protect the clothes of your baby or toddler with this fun bandana bib. These bibs aren't just very practical when it's time for a meal, but also when your baby is teething and drooling a lot.
product.description:
Protect the clothes of your baby or toddler with this fun bandana bib. These bibs aren't just very practical when it's time for a meal, but also when your baby is teething and drooling a lot.

Most babies don't like it when they need a change of clothes too often. These bandana bibs are the perfect solution. The bandanas catch the drool and keep the clothes dry. So your baby won't need fresh clothes so often. You can easily close these bandana bibs with press studs. There are multiple press studs, so the bib will grow along with your babies neck. So you will be able to use it for a long time.

A bandana bib looks a lot cooler than a long bib. The bandanas are available in various colours and prints, so you will be able to match the colour or print with the clothes your baby is wearing. These bibs are delivered in a 2-pack. This way, you will always have a spare one if the first one gets dirty or wet, or if it's in the laundry.

Teddy Bear collection

This sweet teddy bear print is irresistible! This adorable bear will keep your baby company. We have this print on various products, like a little sleeping bag, bibs and even a playpen mat. You can match the Teddy Bear collection with items from our Boucle collection.

Colours

Delivered in a 2-pack. Also available with other prints.

Size

37x24.5 cm.

Material

100% jersey cotton.

Washing

Wash at 60 degrees maximum.

product.name: Babygym Toys - Moon
product.short_description: These four play figures are suitable for use in combination with the Jollein wooden baby gym. From about 10 weeks, your baby has an increasing need for stimulation, playing and looking around. That's when a baby gym offers that extra challenge. Get the wooden baby gym quickly and decorate it with these fun figures in the shape of two moons and two stars. Place your baby underneath on a soft surface and let the play begin! Your baby will find the movements of the toys on the baby gym fascinating to watch. They will enthusiastically kick their feet or make noises when they grab or tap a toy to make it move even more. The use of the baby gym stimulates the development of gross and fine motor skills. It stimulates the senses. In addition, your baby will gain more and more control over its grasping techniques and will learn that toys will move more when you tap or grab toys. So very valuable, such a baby gym. The Jollein baby gym toys are exclusively supplied with the wooden baby gym. The baby gym is available separately and is easy to assemble. There are several matching baby gym toys available in the Jollein collection. You can easily attach and remove the baby toys. This allows you to alternate with the toys and it remains interesting and challenging for your baby.

product.name: Musical Hanger - Moon
product.short_description: Help your little one fall asleep comfortably with this sweet musical mobile. The moon is made of wonderfully soft teddy and has a wooden ring on the drawstring. The musical mobile plays a lullaby and your baby will soon be in dreamland. Hang the musical mobile in the baby room or in the playpen. What do you prefer, green, nougat or pink? This is also a perfect baby shower gift! The musical mobile plays the song 'You are my sunshine' and it plays for about 60 seconds. Lovely teddy Moon musical mobile by Jollein. The soft musical mobile is made of teddy polyester and is about 20 cm tall. The moon musical mobile is available in pink, nougat and green. This item cannot be washed. Always consult the washing label first for further instructions.

product.name: Sleeping Bag - Muslin - Biscuit / 70cm
product.description: Looking for the ultimate sleeping experience for your little one? All our sleeping bags are made from wonderfully soft and breathable materials and feature the trendiest prints, specially designed by our design team, so your little one can sleep in style in every season. Each sleeping bag has a safe and comfortable zipper, making it as easy as possible to put on and take off. When choosing a sleeping bag, always pay attention to the TOG value and compare it with the room temperature. This way, you can always choose the right warmth for your little one. From newborn minis to adventurous toddlers, and from warm summer nights to cold winter days, we make sure your little one sleeps comfortably! This lovely baby sleeping bag has detachable sleeves. Is it a little colder? Simply zip the sleeves back on. Shop our sleeping bags in different colours and in sizes 60, 70, 90 and 110 cm!

product.name: Footmuff group 0+ 3/5 points - Puffed - Biscuit / One Size
product.description: A footmuff is a true asset. You can easily place your baby in the footmuff by completely unzipping the bag first. You can also easily remove your baby from the car seat by unzipping the footmuff completely. In short: an incredibly practical comfort bag for your baby. The footmuff has openings in the back to make attaching belts very easy. It is a universal footmuff for the Maxi Cosi and any other brand of category 0 car seat with three or five-point harness. You can also use this comfort bag in the pram. So your baby will be wrapped up and warm for the walk in no time. This Puffed black footmuff is totally on-trend and matches our other items in the Puffed collection. Think of pouches, diaper bags and backpacks for your mini(s)! Mega cute. This footmuff does not have a TOG rating, as it is designed to keep your little one warm on the go and not to be used as a sleeping bag.
